title: Decision impact
description: The impact map of a merged decision version (packages/naive/src/engine/impact.mjs), written beside the decision as decisions/<id>.impact.json: for each venture function, the records that depend on what the merge changed (by provenance, the where-used list and data-model refs), which of them were marked stale, an agent's note, and the open follow-up decisions proposed. Naive proposes; a person decides.

changed.description: The venture-relative files the merge wrote (applies_to)

note.description: An agent's draft of what changes for this function; null until one is written

proposed_decisions.description: Open follow-up decision ids, proposed, never decided
